{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Count missing values in body_mass_g
missing_count = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()
print(f"Missing values in body_mass_g: {missing_count}")

# Drop rows with missing body_mass_g
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Compute the number of penguins in the cleaned dataset
n_penguins = len(penguins_clean)
print(f"Number of penguins after dropping missing values: {n_penguins}")

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()
print(f"Mean body mass (grams): {mean_body_mass}")"}
